Full-Time Remote | Freelancers May Also Apply

We are looking for a highly creative Motion Graphics Designer who can produce modern, engaging, and visually compelling documentary-style videos for YouTube.

Key Requirements:
Strong expertise in Adobe After Effects and Adobe Premiere Pro
Excellent understanding of cinematic motion graphics and visual storytelling
Ability to create modern, trendy, and eye-catching visuals
Experience working on documentary, educational, or explainer-style content
Strong sense of pacing, transitions, typography, and visual composition
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines consistently
Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with a team

Bonus Skills
Knowledge of Blender or any other 3D software

Basic understanding of color grading and sound design

posts.title: Freelance Documentary Filmmakers – High-End Projects
posts.caption:
Freelance Documentary Filmmakers – High-End Projects

We are looking for freelance filmmakers / production teams / documentary filmmakers who can produce end-to-end, on-ground documentaries across Indian cities.

Requirements
Proven experience in producing full-scale documentaries (samples mandatory).
Must have prior experience shooting on-ground in real locations (cities, events, interviews, etc.).
High-end production setup: professional cameras, sound, lighting, drone, etc.
Individuals or established companies may apply.

Responsibilities
Travel to Indian cities for on-ground documentary shoots (interviews, events, location coverage, b-roll).
Handle complete production: research → shoot → edit → sound/graphics → final master.
Deliver polished, cinematic-quality documentaries.

Engagement
Project basis (long-term possible if quality is proven).
Applications without past documentary samples will not be considered.
📩 Send portfolio + samples to: contact@pinegan.com

posts.title: Researcher & Script Writer
posts.caption:
Researcher & Script Writer

Role Overview:
We are looking for a Researcher & Script Writer who can analyze political events, uncover hidden facts, and craft compelling scripts that resonate with our audience. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of Indian and global politics, history, and socio-economic issues, with the ability to simplify complex topics for mass consumption.

Key Responsibilities:
Conduct in-depth research on political topics, current affairs, historical events, and socio-economic issues.
Develop well-structured scripts that are engaging, fact-based, and aligned with our brand’s tone and style.
Ensure all information is accurate, unbiased, and well-sourced from credible references.

Requirements:
Read, analyze, and extract key insights from research papers, government reports, policy documents, and academic studies.
Strong research skills with experience in fact-checking and investigative research.

Preferred Qualifications:
Ph.D. holders in Political Science, International Relations, Economics, or related fields will have a strong advantage.

Master’s or Ph.D. researchers with experience in political analysis, journalism, or academic writing are highly preferred.

Candidates who have written or published research papers will have an added advantage.

How to Apply:
Interested candidates can send their resume, portfolio, and a sample script or research article to contact@pinegan.com

posts.title: Short-Form Video Script Writer
posts.caption:
Short-Form Video Script Writer

We’re looking for a sharp, fast, and research-driven writer who can turn current topics, politics, public issues, and important developments into engaging short-form video scripts.

The primary focus of this role will be writing scripts for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and short explainer videos.

Role Type
Full-Time | Remote
We are also open to working with freelance writers. If your writing sample and working style are a strong fit, we can consider a freelance collaboration as well.

Who We’re Looking For
We need someone who:

Actively follows what is happening in India and around the world.
Understands politics, current issues, governance, and public-interest stories.
Can quickly identify topics worth making a video about.
Can find an interesting angle instead of simply summarising the news.
Can research complex topics and explain them in simple language.
Knows how to communicate more information in fewer words.
Understands hooks, storytelling, pacing, and audience retention.
Can make serious or complicated subjects interesting without compromising accuracy.
Understands the difference between facts, claims, analysis, and opinions.
Knows how to verify information through credible sources.

Writing Style We Expect
Our ideal scripts are:

Crisp. Engaging. Research-backed. Simple.
Complicated topics should be explained in a way that feels effortless to understand.
Every sentence should add information, context, curiosity, or move the story forward.
We are not looking for textbook-style writing, unnecessary filler, generic news summaries, or AI-sounding scripts.
A strong writer should be able to take a large amount of information and turn it into a short, clear, and engaging story without losing the important details.

What You’ll Be Doing
Your responsibilities will include:

Finding strong and relevant video topics.
Researching current developments and important stories.
Finding the most interesting angle within a topic.
Writing scripts for Shorts and Reels.
Creating strong opening hooks.
Condensing research and context into short, easy-to-follow narratives.
Cross-checking facts and sources.
Writing quickly on fast-moving stories.
Maintaining accuracy while keeping the content highly engaging.

posts.title: 🚨 An Indian vessel has reportedly sunk in the Red Sea. Thankfully, all 13 India
posts.caption:
🚨 An Indian vessel has reportedly sunk in the Red Sea. Thankfully, all 13 Indian sailors were rescued. But the bigger question remains: Who was behind the attack?

On 4 August 2026, the Indian vessel MSV Faize Noore Oliya reportedly sank near Yemen after being struck by what is believed to have been a rocket or drone.

According to available reports, the Yemeni Coast Guard successfully rescued all 13 Indian crew members.

However, responsibility for the attack remains officially unconfirmed.
The Yemeni government has accused the Iran-backed Houthi movement, while India's Ministry of External Affairs has described the incident as "deeply concerning" but has not attributed the attack to any specific group.

This incident comes at a time when global shipping routes are already under pressure due to tensions in the Middle East. With disruptions around the Strait of Hormuz, many commercial vessels have increasingly relied on the Red Sea corridor one of the world's most strategically important maritime routes.

If the attack is eventually confirmed to have targeted an Indian vessel, despite India having no direct conflict with the Houthis, it could have significant implications for regional maritime security and India's commercial interests.

As investigations continue, the focus remains on establishing the facts and ensuring the safety of international shipping.

What do you think this means for India's maritime security strategy?
#India #RedSea #MaritimeSecurity #Geopolitics #Shipping #MiddleEast #IndianNavy #GlobalTrade

posts.title: On 10th May at 10:30 AM, the Pakistani government raised legal complaint & block
posts.caption:
On 10th May at 10:30 AM, the Pakistani government raised legal complaint & blocked my YouTube channel and that became a badge of honour. But what happened next was even more interesting. Within just a few hours, you all came out in support and responded with such strength that the same YouTube channel — the one that was blocked — crossed 7 million subscribers in a few hours. That’s the power of the Indian audience.

Thank you for all the love.

posts.title: Did you know? The cost of healthcare in India can be quite overwhelming!
posts.caption:
Did you know? The cost of healthcare in India can be quite overwhelming!
So I found this infographic online recently. And I was quite shocked, From a simple cataract surgery costing ₹35,000 to a liver transplant at ₹23,00,000  

Most Indians are one hospital bill away from bankruptcy.  Most of the big illnesses, like knee replacement, angioplasty, kidney stone removal run into lakhs of rupees!

For my own health insurance, I trust the good folks over at Ditto Insurance for this - where you’ll get tailored advice, with no spam & 0 pressure to buy. With a quick call with their team I got to understand all the pitfalls of insurance.

posts.title: #NEETEXAM
posts.caption:
#NEETEXAM

NEET UG-2024 results were declared recently and a record number of 67 students secured AIR 1 with a percentile score of 99.997129. 
But the results have raised eyebrows at the National Testing Agency (NTA) as students demand re-exam citing paper leaks, unfair grace marks, and irregularities.

Here’s what happened…

👉  Right after the results were declared, questions were asked on how such an unprecedented number (67) of students secured 720/720 and AIR 1. The number in 2023 was just 2, with students belonging from Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh. 

👉  Another issue raised was that some students have reportedly scored 718, 719. Achieving these scores seemed mathematically impossible. 

However, here’s what the NTA said… 👇

"NTA received few representations and Court cases from the candidates of NEET (UG) 2024 raising concerns of loss of time during the conduct of the examination on 05.05.2024. 
Such cases/representations were considered by NTA and the normalisation formula, which has been devised and adopted by the Hon'ble Apex Court, vide its judgement dates 13.06.2018, was implemented to address the loss of time faced by the candidates of NEET (UG) 2024.
The loss of examination time was ascertained and such candidates were compensated with grace marks.
So, candidate's marks can be 718 or 719  also"

🚨 NTA awarded grace marks per court order, but students argue this sudden decision is unjust as the agency has not mentioned any methodology to award these ‘grace marks’. Calls for transparency in the process have only grown louder. 

🔍 It gets a little more tricky if we closely notice the roll numbers of students who appeared for the examination from Haryana…

👉 Out of the 8 roll numbers with starting sequence of ‘2307010’ have been reported to belong to the same exam center in the state and have secured top ranks. These unusual patterns in top scorers' roll numbers have further fuelled doubts. Students demand re-evaluation and clear answers.

The controversy for the NTA is brewing as lakhs of students demand re-examination citing lack of clarity in NTA's explanations and have even pushed for the Supreme Court’s intervention. Grace marks given for lost exam time have raised concerns of fairness.

#NEET #Indianeducation

posts.title: Follow these steps to get 5M views on your next YouTube short…
posts.caption:
Follow these steps to get 5M views on your next YouTube short…

Caught in those clickbait headlines again!

Well, the truth is, you can never predict the virality of the content you post.
Having worked on YouTube for many years, I still can't predict the number of views I'll get on my next post.

There have been instances where the content my team and I researched for a month, shot, expecting it to crack more than regular views later sat at average viewership.

On the other hand, another simple idea performed exceptionally well.

I agree with the fact that data and insights offer some trend hints, but there's no guarantee.

No youtube shorts or reels can teach you to go viral in ‘60 secs’.

There's no rulebook for making content. Every creator is different. What works for me can be a flop for you.

Avoid wasting your time searching for YouTube videos on “how to go viral in 5 days”!

Instead, start creating content. Don't wait for the perfect time.

As Stephen Hawking aptly said,

"It is all right to make mistakes; nothing is perfect because with perfection, we would not exist."

#youtube #viralcontent

Type: Full Time Remote work

Note: We are not simply looking for an editor or a senior editor. We are looking for a senior video producer. This individual will be in charge of managing the team and supervising the entirety of video production, as well as the general atmosphere and narrative of the video.

This role requires proficiency in video editing & Production  software, a keen eye for detail, and excellent project management skills.

Quality Assurance: Conduct quality checks on edited videos to ensure accuracy, consistency, and adherence to Channel standards. Continuously refine and improve editing techniques to enhance the overall quality of video content.
Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with internal stakeholders to understand project requirements and objectives. Effectively communicate ideas, feedback, and project updates to ensure alignment and successful project delivery.
Qualifications:

Proven experience in video editing and production, with a strong portfolio showcasing creative and technical skills.
Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar tools.
Solid understanding of cinematography, storytelling principles, and visual aesthetics.
Excellent project management skills, with the ability to organize, plan, and execute video projects from concept to completion.
Attention to detail and a passion for delivering high-quality work.
Flexibility to adapt to changing project requirements and priorities.
Bachelor’s degree in film production, media studies, or a related field is a huge advantage.

posts.author: Nitish Rajput
posts.title: #unpopularopinion
posts.caption:
#unpopularopinion 

Not everyone in the world hates their 9-to-5 job.
Not everyone in the world is trying to be a ‘Rancho’ of 3 idiots.Social media has made it a trend to complain about toxic work cultures in the corporate world. However, this doesn't paint the whole picture.Many of my friends in the corporate world are leading happy lives, proving that
"You don't need to quit your job to live a dream life."
And surely 9-to-5 has its own perks :)
Your job ends as soon as the clock hits five, unlike mine where you are recording content at 3 in the morning ;)
You have your salary credited on the 1st of every month. 
And if you give your best, promotions are waiting for you with open arms!Personally, I have experienced both ways. I worked hard in the corporate world and got success. But I was not pleased.I still remember how I initially started making content and it took me a lot of time to make a place for myself. 

But producing content has always been my love.If money was not the driving force, I would still be making content :)I used to wish my dear ones by recording birthday videos.
I remember how I used to write scripts and shoot content while managing my job alongside.

So, here's my message: If you're not happy with your job, try to listen to your heart.

Do it for yourself, not just because you saw an Instagram reel.

Remember, no profession is easy.
It will become boring and tiring after some time. 

The key is to give your 100% to what you truly love and watch the magic happen. 

At last “all shall be well”.

#passion #growth #career

posts.title: Ever had your heart race so fast, you could hear it in your ears?
posts.caption:
Ever had your heart race so fast, you could hear it in your ears?

In my school days, I had this experience.

It all happened on the stage of a debate competition.

See, I was always the kid who asked tons of questions about everything, from fish breathing underwater (this was just the beginning, trust me) to the mysteries of the universe.  

Knowing my skills and curiosity, my dad got me enrolled me in a debate competition.

I had planned a ton of things to say during the debate. My mind was filled with different opinions, I was fully prepared for my first debate. Rare, right? 

But as soon as the debate started, everyone was firing away their points. I tried to find a pause in the conversation to jump in, but there weren’t any. 

At the end, I spoke nothing, my confidence was shattered. 

Came back and told my Dad that I am going to withdraw my name. 

He heard me, remained calm and said ‘kal ek last try kar, if mann nahi laga toh chod denge’, to which I agreed. 

He then gave me one piece of advice, the advice was simple: when the debate starts, just boldly say, "I don't agree!" Just say it out loud! 

I did the same. That negative statement gave me a chance to speak up and I did. My confidence skyrocketed! 

Suddenly, I was THE man in the debate. 

This experience instilled in me the confidence to address crowds. 

So, If you lack confidence, instead of agreeing on everything, try questioning, try putting your point forward and give it a shot, everything will eventually fall into place.

Did you have such a moment? 

#confidencebuilding #publicspeaking

posts.title: 1. When you shop and come back, avoid talking about your purchases in the ricksh
posts.caption:
1. When you shop and come back, avoid talking about your purchases in the rickshaw or auto. The driver will feel bad because he can't buy the same for his kids.

2. Help your maid with work; she has more work on Diwali.

3. Give some sweets to the safayiwala (ragpicker) who comes to our houses, so he may have something nice to hold for a change.

4. Don't discuss your office Diwali gifts in front of a person who has not received gifts from his company or lost his job. 

We will surely have a happy Diwali, but there are people less fortunate than us who won't. Don't make them feel that. Include them in your love. Happy Diwali in advance 😊🙏🏻  
                                                   
                                                    - Nitish Rajput

posts.title: You know that feeling of warmth and pure comfort when you eat your mother's home
posts.caption:
You know that feeling of warmth and pure comfort when you eat your mother's homemade aloo paratha with lots of butter?

I felt something similar on my recent trip to London.

I'd been in London for over a week and was really missing Indian food. So, I found an Indian restaurant called "Gymkhana" using Google Maps.

While I was eating, a sweet Indian couple in their 60s came up to me. They tried to recognise me, "Are you Nitish from YouTube?"

The lady said, "Thank you for your work, beta," and blessed me with all her heart. They were so excited to tell me that they were among my first 50k followers!

It was really different from the usual interaction I have with people, and it felt special.
They told me they'd been living in London for over 30 years but still loved to keep up with what was happening in India.

They used to read newspapers, but now they watch videos and listen to audio content.

Sometimes you don't realize how much of a difference you can make in the world just by doing what you love. Meeting that couple was one of the best experiences I've ever had, and it made me feel amazing.

Whenever I feel down, I think about that moment, and it always cheers me up

#youtubecommunity #connections #happiness

posts.title: After joining the corporate world as a fresher and getting promoted to Vice Pres
posts.caption:
After joining the corporate world as a fresher and getting promoted to Vice President, I quit my job.

I had gotten into the IT industry straight after college. After 10 years in the industry, I had:

- Worked in multiple leadership roles
- Received various awards and accolades
- Been promoted to my dream position of VP

I had been building this life for over a decade. But I realised I still wasn’t satisfied. I had achieved my goals, but was left wanting more.

I’d always been interested in video editing and content creation. So I decided to dive deeper into this passion, and started a YouTube channel.

There was a lot of figuring out to do — research, scripts, lighting, editing… but I worked long hours after work and made sure I did the best job possible.

Luckily, my effort paid off. My first video was able to impact 500k+ people, and the next few were able to educate millions more.

I saw potential here, but didn’t want to rely on content as my income.

I had also always wanted to build something of my own, so I left my job and stepped into the entrepreneurial landscape, starting an IT consulting company.

A lot of people told me I was making a mistake since my life was ‘sorted’, but I knew I had to follow my heart.

posts.title: I had to fire one of my talented team members for something that wasn’t his faul
posts.caption:
I had to fire one of my talented team members for something that wasn’t his fault.

A few months ago, I had hired Arun (name changed) as a Manager in my company.

His resume was great, he was well-spoken, and seemed quite intelligent. So I was looking forward to having him join us.

But 3 weeks in, some cracks began to appear in this decision.

Arun was a focused worker, but he was also a perfectionist who had difficulties with tight deadlines.

I had no issues with the quality of his work, but he just couldn’t keep up with the fast-paced, high pressure environment at our company.

So after a few months of back-and-forth, I realised he wasn’t the right fit and action was required.

However, I didn’t fire him right off the bat. 

I met him for a 1-on-1 conversation and heard his perspective as well. Together, we came to the conclusion that though he was dedicated to the work, this job just didn’t suit him.

He was quite distraught that we were letting him go, and I didn’t want someone with his skills to struggle for a job either.

So I spoke to a few friends of mine, and got him placed in a research-based job, with lower pressure and less harsh deadlines.

Arun was glad, and he thrived in this environment! He’s still there to this day, and my friend (his boss) speaks highly of him.

So the next time you’re ‘bad at something’, remember that your performance is the result of many internal and external factors.

It’s not necessarily your fault, so figure out what’s affecting you negatively, and try finding an environment you’ll thrive in.

Have you ever been in a similar situation?

#workculture #careergrowth #entrepreneurship

posts.title: As a teenager, I used to believe everything I saw on the news, and argued with p
posts.caption:
As a teenager, I used to believe everything I saw on the news, and argued with people who disagreed with me.

But as I got older, I realised that I was letting media outlets influence me too easily. 

I was forming opinions too quickly and defending them blindly, without trying to understand the bigger picture.

So I could never stand my ground in arguments, and came off looking ignorant.

As I grew older, I realised I shouldn’t rely upon only one source of information to form an opinion about world events. Because no matter how much a publication claims to be ‘neutral’, it doesn’t tell you the full story.

The writer or media house usually focuses on one side of the events, and it’s only human to have preferences, so that’s not a bad thing.

But I wanted to be fully educated about the topics I spoke about, and found a better way.

I started to:

- Identify relevant experts from both sides
- Read up about their opinions independently
- Form an opinion based on what I felt was right

For example, whenever there is a political dispute in India, I make sure to listen to the perspectives of right-wing and left-wing leaders both, before deciding who I think is being more rational.

I highly suggest you do the same, as this will keep you fully informed, and help you understand the depths of the topic.

Plus if you ever end up discussing it with friends and family, they’ll respect your knowledge even if they have an opposing opinion.

#news  #awareness #knowledge #growthmindset

posts.title: I’ve noticed one common mistake that stops aspiring creators from growing their
posts.caption:
I’ve noticed one common mistake that stops aspiring creators from growing their channel beyond 100k followers:

We start relying on our content’s monetisation to support us financially.

I’ve realised that if you seriously want to grow your audience, your content should NEVER be your primary source of income. 

If you get too reliant on this, your content will be driven mainly by views. You’ll put yourself under pressure to produce mass-appealing content at a rate where your quality will be compromised.

And if your posts don’t go viral, you’ll be left dejected (and broke).

So if you want to become a serious creator, here are some ways you can safely diversify your monetisation: 

1. Create online courses to share in-depth knowledge. 

2. Collaborate with brands that you truly resonate with.

3. Use affiliate marketing to share products you swear by.

4. Create merch for your fans if you’re passionate about fashion.

But the best option of all:

Create a business and use your online reach as a sales funnel.

I’ve created a community of 4 million+ members, and content creation is still my passion (not my job). So the income from it is just a bonus.

This helps me focus on quality without worrying too much about the results.

Do you think becoming a full-time creator is a viable option?

#creators #contentcreation #personalbranding

posts.title: After interviewing over 150 people throughout my career, I’ve realised that peop
posts.caption:
After interviewing over 150 people throughout my career, I’ve realised that people don’t get hired for their CV.

Your resume is just to get your foot in the door — the first round of qualification. 

After that, here’s what recruiters really look for:

1. Commitment

We need to figure out if a candidate is actually passionate and serious about this role, and what their future plans are. People with a long-term vision are great assets to their company, and that’s who we try to find.

2. Coachability

If someone has their ways set in stone, it’s difficult for them to adapt to new situations. What I value are sharp individuals who respond positively to new challenges and pick up new concepts with ease.

3. Experience

I don’t just hire the person with the most years of experience. I look for people who have faced relevant challenges and come out on top. This is what shows me that they’ll be the right fit for the job.

4. Understanding

To help them hit the ground running, new team members need to be able to understand information quickly and act upon it smartly. So I look for people who are intelligent and fast learners.

Please note that CVs are still very important to qualify you for the job and make a good first impression. So put a lot of effort into it to help you stand out.

After that, use this insider knowledge to bring out these qualities in your interview, and nail your job application.

What’s your dream job?

#righttalent #jobhunt #freshers #careerdevelopment #opportunities

posts.title: The British looted an estimated $45,000,000,000,000 from India. But we’re the fa
posts.caption:
The British looted an estimated $45,000,000,000,000 from India. But we’re the fastest growing economy today, while they struggle against inflation.

The British East India Company came to India in 1608, with the goal of trading spices like the valuable ‘black gold’ AKA pepper.

But they saw that the real money came with political power, and slowly started to conquer parts of India.

They used cheating, bribery and backstabbing to get power in our country, then forced the public to pay exorbitant taxes, sending our wealth back to their homeland.

While Indians drowned in poverty and died of famine, the Brits prospered. Till 1947, they looted an estimated $45 trillion USD from Indians.

Even after looting all this money, the British economy is in tatters now, while the Indian economy found its way back, and has the fastest growing GDP in the world.

As for the East India Company? It lost all its power after the Brits were forced out of our country, and was forced to shut down.

248 years after the British unjustly conquered our country, India is on its way to becoming a world superpower again.

Our nation is built upon the spirit of resilience, and it makes me proud to call myself Indian. We never give up, and fight through our battles to come out stronger. 

#india #economics #business #entrepreneurship #independenceday

posts.title: When I started creating content, I made a list of factors that made me dislike a
posts.caption:
When I started creating content, I made a list of factors that made me dislike a video.

Number 1 on the list was — When the creator doesn’t value my time.

So I made my videos as concise and value-rich as possible, making sure I made the most efficient use of my viewer’s attention.

Here’s how you can do this too:

1. Avoid a typical intro and outro

Avoid the small talk at the beginning and jump straight into the video, and don’t waste time asking people to subscribe at the end.

2. Invest time in research

70% of the time it takes to produce a video should go towards research. This makes your content impactful and points stronger.

3. Try to talk faster

It might sound silly, but doing this helps you pack in more value in a shorter amount of time, and helps you keep their attention.

If you respect your viewers, they’ll respect you too.

So make the best use of their time, cut out the fluff, and watch your community grow.

#contentcreation #YouTube #creators

posts.title: I create content on YouTube for millions of subscribers, while running an IT con
posts.caption:
I create content on YouTube for millions of subscribers, while running an IT consulting company.

My secret to managing this? These time management frameworks:


1. Autofocusing

If you’re not a fan of rigid schedules, this free-spirited approach will help you reduce stress and raise productivity.

⚬ Don’t keep a time-table and whenever possible, avoid blocking out time slots. This keeps you flexible and motivated.

⚬ Create 3 lists. A “to-do list” for key tasks, a “watch list” for projects you’re supervising, and a “later list” for the stuff you’d like to do.

⚬ Start when and where you feel like it. Let your motivation and excitement act as a compass to guide which important tasks you should tackle first.


2. The Eisenhower Matrix

When you have too much to do and not enough time, prioritisation is key. Write down your tasks with 2 checkboxes next to them - ‘Important’ and ‘Urgent’.

⚬ Important + Urgent = DO

⚬ Important + Not Urgent = DECIDE

⚬ Urgent + Not Important = DELEGATE

⚬ Not Urgent + Not Important = DELETE


3. The Pomodoro Method

Short burst of focused work >>> Hours of sitting at your desk distracted. This technique uses this philosophy to cut out interruptions and battle fatigue.

⚬ Identify a specific task, and sit at your desk without any distractions (put your phone on silent).

⚬ Set a timer for 25 minutes and begin your work. Don’t let anything take your attention away from the task at hand.

⚬ When the timer goes off, take a 5 minute break.

⚬ Break this cycle with a longer, 30 minute pause for every 4th break.

It sounds easy, but it’s so effective!


I live by these 3 frameworks, and I’m glad I put in the time to research these early on in my career.

Try these out, and you’ll get more done than ever in just a day’s work.

P.S. - Another personal favourite is the 2 minute rule. 

It’s simple — If a task takes less than 2 minutes, do it RIGHT NOW without pushing it for the future.

But I’d love to hear from you as well. What’s your best time management hack?

posts.title: *Will AI Take Jobs? Have You Experienced It?*
posts.caption:
*Will AI Take Jobs? Have You Experienced It?*

All the buzz these days is about AI, all we hear there says is AI or Artificial Intelligence. Everyone around us talks about AI. Is it worth the hype? Are the claims of AI takeover true?

Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly evolving, and there is growing concern that it will lead to job losses. Some experts believe that AI will automate many jobs, while others believe that it will create new jobs.

So, what is the truth? Will AI take jobs?

The answer is not simple. It is likely that AI will automate some jobs, but it is also likely that it will create new jobs. The net effect of AI on jobs is still uncertain.

However, there are some trends that we can already see. For example, AI is already being used to automate tasks in manufacturing, customer service, and healthcare. This has led to job losses in some of these industries.

At the same time, AI is also creating new jobs. For example, there is a growing demand for AI engineers and data scientists. These are the people who are responsible for developing and deploying AI systems.

So, what does this mean for you? If you are worried about AI taking your job, there are a few things you can do. First, you can start learning about AI and how it is being used in your industry. This will help you to understand the potential impact of AI on your job.

Second, you can start developing skills that are complementary to AI. For example, if you are a customer service representative, you could start learning about AI customer service chatbots. This will help you to stay relevant in your job even as AI automates some of your tasks.

posts.title: Have you ever found yourself doubting your own abilities and feeling like you do
posts.caption:
Have you ever found yourself doubting your own abilities and feeling like you don't deserve the successes you've achieved? It's a common struggle that many of us face at some point in our lives. But here's the thing: you have the power to overcome it and cultivate unwavering confidence in yourself. Let me share a 5 - Step guide to help you overcome this feeling.

1. First, it's important to recognize that self-doubt is a natural part of being human. We all experience moments of uncertainty and questioning our capabilities. But remember, your doubts don't define you. They are simply thoughts and not an accurate reflection of your true potential.

2. Next, take the time to acknowledge and celebrate your achievements. Write them down and reflect on the hard work, skills, and dedication that have led to your successes. Recognize that you have earned every milestone along the way. By appreciating your accomplishments, you can start building a solid foundation of self-belief.

3. Embrace a growth mindset. View challenges as opportunities for learning and personal development. Instead of fearing failure, see it as a stepping stone on your path to success. Embrace new experiences, take risks, and learn from both triumphs and setbacks. Remember, every setback is a chance to grow stronger and wiser.

4. Seek out a supportive network of mentors, peers, and colleagues. Surround yourself with individuals who believe in your abilities and encourage your personal and professional growth. Their guidance, feedback, and encouragement can provide valuable insights and help you gain a fresh perspective on your journey.

5. Lastly, practice self-compassion and be kind to yourself. Treat yourself with the same level of understanding and kindness that you would offer to a friend facing self-doubt. Acknowledge that making mistakes is part of the learning process, and be gentle with yourself during challenging times. Nurture your well-being, both mentally and physically, as it plays a crucial role in building and maintaining confidence.

Remember, building confidence is an ongoing journey. It takes time and effort, but with consistent practice, you can develop unshakeable belief in your abilities. Trust in yourself, celebrate your accomplishments, embrace growth, seek support, and practice self-compassion. You are capable of great things, and your potential knows no bounds.

Have you been through this ever? If not, then what steps will you take today to overcome self-doubt and embrace unwavering confidence? Share your thoughts and experiences in the comments below. Let's support and inspire each other as we navigate the path to personal and professional success!

#SelfConfidence #PersonalDevelopment #ProfessionalGrowth #OvercomingSelfDoubt #BelieveInYourself

posts.title: The Changing Landscape of Work
posts.caption:
The Changing Landscape of Work

Over the years, there has been a significant shift in the way we approach work, I have noticed and implemented it myself. So today I want to discuss with you all of what you think about this change in the industry?

In the past, a college degree was everything and people were obsessed with having one.

However, with the changing times, the industry is now shifting towards a more skill-based hiring process and major companies have even begun removing the college degree requirement for certain positions.

Employers now value skills obtained through alternative routes such as online courses, vocational training, and apprenticeships, creating a more inclusive workforce.

Another advantage of skill-based hiring is that it allows employers to focus on what really matters - the skills required for the job.

This approach to hiring ensures that the right candidate is selected for the job based on their skills and not just their academic qualifications. It also helps in closing the skills gap that exists in the job market, as employers are now able to identify candidates with the specific skills required for the job.

In my opinion, it is a welcome change but I’m more interested to know your views on this, let me know your take on this new direction the industry is heading to, in the comments below.
.
#work #skills #hiring #education #economy

posts.author: Nitish Rajput
posts.title: Embrace the Journey!
posts.caption:
Embrace the Journey!

I’m sure you all must be going through this or would have experienced this at some point in life, that when you’re learning something new, some new skill, some new talent, the path is not easy. 
It’s tiring, exhausting, fun and tiring again. So today, Let me take you on a ride through my experience of learning and personal growth.

Learning new skills is no cakewalk. It demands a lot out of you. There were moments when I felt like throwing in the towel, questioning if all this effort would lead to anything. But those setbacks and failures, they're just part of the game! I learned to embrace them, to see them as stepping stones to my growth. That's what kept me going!

Now, let's talk about "me" time, that's my secret sauce! In the midst of this crazy pursuit, I realized that taking a breather and focusing on myself was crucial. I found solace in pursuing my hobbies, or simply getting lost in a good read. Those moments of solitude brought back my peace, gave me a fresh perspective, and reignited my fire to keep going.

But you know what really got me through the toughest times? It was the unwavering support of my amazing family, my loving partner, and my incredible friends. They became my personal cheering squad, always there to lift me up when self-doubt crept in. Their belief in me fueled my motivation like nothing else. 

And let's not forget about being self-motivated. I discovered the power of setting clear goals, breaking them down into bite-sized chunks, and celebrating each tiny victory along the way. I embraced a positive mindset, focusing on my progress rather than dwelling on setbacks. That self-belief became my superpower!

So, here's the bottom line, my fellow adventurers: skill acquisition ain't easy. It's a journey of hard work, struggle, and a whole lot of perseverance. But trust me, the results are worth every drop of effort. Take that "me" time, lean on your loved ones, and dig deep to find your own self-motivation.

Remember, every step forward, no matter how small, brings you closer to your goals and becoming the one you were meant to be. Now, go out there and conquer the world!

Also I know some of you have gone through this phase, so write your story in the comments for the ones who are going through this still and inspire them. #experience #learning #growth #motivation #mindset

posts.title: Dubai is an entrepreneur’s dream. No taxes, abundant opportunities and countless
posts.caption:
Dubai is an entrepreneur’s dream. No taxes, abundant opportunities and countless wealthy investors and clients.

But while moving to Dubai is easy, getting citizenship there is extremely difficult.

Dubai is home to 35 lakh people, of which only 3 lakh are Emirati (originally from the UAE).

Because the Emirati are outnumbered by immigrants, citizenship and voting rights are handed out very selectively.

Generally, citizenship is granted to:

- Arab people who settled there before 1925.
- Children born to existing UAE nationals.

“Okay, but what if I marry an existing citizen?”

Getting a citizenship through marriage isn’t easy either. 

It is only offered to women marrying an Emirate man:

- In 7 years if they have a child together.
- In 10 years if they don’t.

If you’re a man with non-Emirati parents, there is one way though.

UAE citizenship is also offered to reputable doctors, scientists, artists, investors and inventors.

However, you need 10 years of experience and international awards, and can’t have any criminal record to avail this.

Have you ever wanted to move to Dubai?

PS: I've also made a video about how Dubai got so rich, you may watch it on my Youtube channel

https://lnkd.in/dK3b2DjQ

#dubai #business #entrepreneurship #UAE

posts.title: I transformed my career and life by taking things into my own hands.
posts.caption:
I transformed my career and life by taking things into my own hands.

I worked in an IT job for over 10 years. I made a very comfortable amount of money, but did not want to lead the life of a cog in a wheel.

So in the pursuit of satisfaction, I shifted my focus away from the corporate world and became a creator.

I’m so much happier as an entrepreneur and creator, and this experience helped me realise that you can make a career out of ANYTHING in 2023.

I just asked myself one question to get started:

”What work would I do even if nobody paid me a single rupee for it?”

My answer couldn’t just be leisure activities, since I couldn’t make a career out of that.

So I narrowed my choices down to activities through which I could help people in some way.

This could be in the form of:

- Entertainment

- Empowerment

- Education 

- Business 

That’s when I realised I loved spreading knowledge, and helping empower people. 

I also noticed how skewed current affairs are on social media, and decided that since I enjoyed creating videos, creating content on these lines would be the perfect fit.

Once I had that figured out, I took action to achieve my newfound goals.

I made a plan, learnt the required skills, and started making YouTube videos.

I’m glad I took the required action to pivot my career trajectory, because my work (and life) is much more fulfilling now.

What work would you do if you never got paid for it?

#career #growthmindset #contentcreation #enterpreneurship

posts.title: Today, I want to share a personal story that I bet many of you can relate to: th
posts.caption:
Today, I want to share a personal story that I bet many of you can relate to: the never-ending quest for work-life balance.

Not long ago, I was stuck in the chaos of work, constantly sacrificing my personal time and well-being. Burning the midnight oil, rushing to meet deadlines, and forgetting to take care of myself became the norm. But, let me tell you, it took a toll on me!

So, I decided to embark on a journey of self-discovery, which eventually did open my eyes! I realized that achieving work-life harmony wasn't just a fancy idea—it required me to take control of my choices.

I started by setting clear boundaries and prioritising things that I loved, making content was one of them.  I also carved out dedicated time for family, hobbies, and self-care. And soon enough those became my non-negotiables.

But what changed the game for me: I discovered the power of delegation and collaboration. Trusting my awesome colleagues with some responsibilities not only lightened my load, but it also empowered the whole team. We started achieving amazing results while still having a life outside of work!

Work-life balance isn't about being perfect every day. It's about being mindful and making choices that prioritize your well-being.

And I know I’m not perfect, so I’m out here to learn from you guys as well, How do you currently prioritize your personal time amidst work demands? 

What strategies have you found helpful in maintaining work-life harmony? 

Have you ever felt guilty for saying "no" to work-related tasks? How did you overcome it? Are there any hobbies or self-care practices that you've neglected but want to get back into?

Let me know your thoughts in the comments below, and I’ll be reading all of them.

#delegation #worklifebalance #livingthewelllife

Nurture your well-being, both mentally and physically, as it plays a crucial role in building and maintaining confidence.

Remember, building confidence is an ongoing journey. It takes time and effort, but with consistent practice, you can develop unshakeable belief in your abilities. Trust in yourself, celebrate your accomplishments, embrace growth, seek support, and practice self-compassion. You are capable of great things, and your potential knows no bounds.

Have you been through this ever? If not, then what steps will you take today to overcome self-doubt and embrace unwavering confidence? Share your thoughts and experiences in the comments below. Let's support and inspire each other as we navigate the path to personal and professional success!

posts.title: #Research
posts.caption:
#Research

My YouTube channel recently hit 2.5 million subscribers, and there’s one key factor I attribute this growth to:

My research process.

This allows me to create highly relevant, unbiased and fact-driven content that helped me reach huge audiences.

The best part? It all happens on 3 Google tools, which are completely free to use.

Today, I’m sharing this process with you.

1. Create a framework

Search for books on the topic you’ve chosen. You can then preview these on Google Books, and see the index. Use this to create a structure for your content piece.

2. Find resources

Google Scholar is a researcher’s best friend. Find relevant published articles, use Ctrl+F to look for specific points, and compile these on a document.

3. Dig deeper

Let’s say you’re researching AI tools. Use Google Advanced Search to narrow search results, using these commands:

- related:chatgpt - Helps you find pages related to a given topic.
- filetype:pdf - Use this to find reports and analyses.
- after:2022 - Get more recent, relevant results.

Change the keywords after the : based on your topic.

Once you have all this refined information within your reach, all you have to do is write your script and move towards the production.

Which of these tools will you be incorporating into your research process?

#contentcreation #research #youtube

posts.title: Embrace the Journey!
posts.caption:
Embrace the Journey!

I’m sure you all must be going through this or would have experienced this at some point in life, that when you’re learning something new, some new skill, some new talent, the path is not easy. 
It’s tiring, exhausting, fun and tiring again. So today, Let me take you on a ride through my experience of learning and personal growth.

Learning new skills is no cakewalk. It demands a lot out of you. There were moments when I felt like throwing in the towel, questioning if all this effort would lead to anything. But those setbacks and failures, they're just part of the game! I learned to embrace them, to see them as stepping stones to my growth. That's what kept me going!

Now, let's talk about "me" time, that's my secret sauce! In the midst of this crazy pursuit, I realized that taking a breather and focusing on myself was crucial. I found solace in pursuing my hobbies, or simply getting lost in a good read. Those moments of solitude brought back my peace, gave me a fresh perspective, and reignited my fire to keep going.

But you know what really got me through the toughest times? It was the unwavering support of my amazing family, my loving partner, and my incredible friends. They became my personal cheering squad, always there to lift me up when self-doubt crept in. Their belief in me fueled my motivation like nothing else. 

And let's not forget about being self-motivated. I discovered the power of setting clear goals, breaking them down into bite-sized chunks, and celebrating each tiny victory along the way. I embraced a positive mindset, focusing on my progress rather than dwelling on setbacks. That self-belief became my superpower!

So, here's the bottom line, my fellow adventurers: skill acquisition ain't easy. It's a journey of hard work, struggle, and a whole lot of perseverance. But trust me, the results are worth every drop of effort. Take that "me" time, lean on your loved ones, and dig deep to find your own self-motivation.

Remember, every step forward, no matter how small, brings you closer to your goals and becoming the one you were meant to be. Now, go out there and conquer the world!

Also I know some of you have gone through this phase, so write your story in the comments for the ones who are going through this still and inspire them. #experience #learning #growth #motivation #mindset

posts.caption:
QATAR has never in the history of FIFA ever qualified for the football world cup tournament.
Only this time they did, by the special rule in FIFA which states that any country which hosts the FIFA world cup automatically qualifies for the world cup tournament.

The big question is how did Qatar manage to get enough votes in the bid to host world cup while  competing with the USA, after all the country has so little football history.

And all does not ends well because over 6000 migrant workers have been stated to have lost their lives due to mistreatment and terrible working conditions in the country (mostly from neighbouring countries like India Nepal Bangladesh Pakistan). 

QATAR has even refused to pay any compensation to the mourning families of these labourers while on the other hand, they are paying David Beckham 150 million dollars to be the face of the world cup.

This hosting has brought more humiliation to the country than honour.

What are your views?

posts.title: Today, I want to share a personal story that I bet many of you can relate to: th
posts.caption:
Today, I want to share a personal story that I bet many of you can relate to: the never-ending quest for work-life balance.

Not long ago, I was stuck in the chaos of work, constantly sacrificing my personal time and well-being. Burning the midnight oil, rushing to meet deadlines, and forgetting to take care of myself became the norm. But, let me tell you, it took a toll on me!

So, I decided to embark on a journey of self-discovery, which eventually did open my eyes! I realized that achieving work-life harmony wasn't just a fancy idea—it required me to take control of my choices.

I started by setting clear boundaries and prioritising things that I loved, making content was one of them.  I also carved out dedicated time for family, hobbies, and self-care. And soon enough those became my non-negotiables.

But what changed the game for me: I discovered the power of delegation and collaboration. Trusting my awesome colleagues with some responsibilities not only lightened my load, but it also empowered the whole team. We started achieving amazing results while still having a life outside of work!

Work-life balance isn't about being perfect every day. It's about being mindful and making choices that prioritize your well-being.

And I know I’m not perfect, so I’m out here to learn from you guys as well, How do you currently prioritize your personal time amidst work demands? 

What strategies have you found helpful in maintaining work-life harmony? 

Have you ever felt guilty for saying "no" to work-related tasks? How did you overcome it? Are there any hobbies or self-care practices that you've neglected but want to get back into?

Let me know your thoughts in the comments below, and I’ll be reading all of them.

#delegation #worklifebalance #livingthewelllife

-However, according to a CNBC-TV18 report, Yadav is the same petitioner who had earlier filed a PIL questioning the construction of the Taj Mahal by Shah Jahan.
